:::{#def-epe}
#### Expected squared prediction error at a covariate value

The **expected squared prediction error at $\predvar$**
of a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) $\fitproc$
at training-set size $\nobs$
is the mean squared [prediction error](prediction.qmd#def-prediction-error)
of its prediction at $\predvar$ for a new outcome $\newoutvar$ with $\newpredvar = \predvar$,
averaged over random [training sets](#def-training-set) $\trainset$ of $\nobs$ observations
drawn independently of $(\newpredvar, \newoutvar)$,
and over $\newoutvar$:

$$
\epe{\fitproc}{\nobs}{\predvar} \eqdef \E{\sqf{\fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset} - \newoutvar} \mid \newpredvar = \predvar}.
$$ {#eq-epe}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.3], who write this quantity as $\generr(x_0)$.
:::
